events.headline: IRAN ATTACKS US MILITARY BASES IN BAHRAIN, KUWAIT, AND JORDAN

events.headline: US AND IRAN TRADE FIRE AS TENSIONS RISE OVER STRAIT OF HORMUZ

events.detail: The US has launched a new wave of strikes on Iran targeting Tehran's ability to threaten shipping in the strait.
